description: This file defines an abstract base class for journaling tests in the Orleans framework, setting up dependency injection, service providers, and common utilities for testing state machine components.

classes.name: StateMachineTestBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing setup and utility methods for journaling tests involving state machines in Orleans.

classes.name: GrainLifecycle
classes.description: A nested private class within StateMachineTestBase that extends LifecycleSubject and implements IGrainLifecycle, managing lifecycle stages.

methods.name: StateMachineTestBase
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependency injection services and required components.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates an in-memory storage instance for testing.

methods.name: CreateTestSystem
methods.description: Creates and returns a system with an in-memory state machine manager, storage, and lifecycle.

methods.name: GetStageName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a lifecycle stage based on its integer identifier.
